visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Establishing shot of a detailed indoor desktop setup featuring a large monitor and a smaller laptop. The large screen displays a YouTube channel page titled 'It's Berry M.', while the laptop is playing a historical Chinese drama with subtitles. Warm lighting from a desk lamp illuminates the workspace and several posters on the wall. (2) The camera performs a smooth pan from the laptop screen over to the large desktop monitor. Various desktop icons for creative software like Photoshop and Premiere are visible at the bottom of the screen. The background wall is decorated with colorful posters and a red Chinese character sign, creating a personalized atmosphere. (3) A close-up shot focuses specifically on the desk surface where a pink Apple Magic Keyboard and a white mouse are neatly placed. The dark wood texture of the desk contrasts with the bright color of the keyboard. Nearby, a coffee mug and small character figurines are visible in the soft lighting. (4) A person wearing a purple oversized hoodie enters the frame and takes a seat in front of the monitors. The camera captures this from a high angle and back-view perspective, showing the person's hair tied up in a bun. The laptop continues to play the drama in the background. (5) The person begins to type actively on the pink keyboard while looking at the large monitor. To the right, the laptop screen displays a scene from a period drama featuring characters in elaborate traditional costumes. The setting remains stable, illuminated by the steady glow of the overhead lamp. (6) An extreme close-up shot highlights the person's fingers as they type quickly on the pink keys. The lighting emphasizes the matte surface of the keyboard and the fluid movement of the hands. The dark wood of the desk serves as a backdrop for this high-focus interaction. (7) The scene transitions to a wooden storage cabinet with a sliding glass door, which contains several customized mechanical keyboards. A hand reaches into the frame to slide the glass door open briefly and then closes it, showcasing the variety of peripheral items in the collection. (8) The final shot returns to a wide view of the desk setup with the person still seated and working. The entire environment is visible, from the decorated wall posters to the glowing screens and the warm desk lamp, concluding the montage of the aesthetic workspace.
